verified_scope_note: Covers personal, non-commercial import of a dog into the United States from a CDC low-risk-origin country. This is the CDC federal dog-import layer only (not USDA/APHIS, CBP inspection, airline, or US-state requirements). CBP's documentation check and visual inspection on arrival are decided outside Petra.

caveats.text: A US Customs and Border Protection officer performs the documentation check and visual inspection when your dog arrives at the US port of entry; Petra cannot pre-clear this step.

requirements.title: At least 6 months old at arrival
CDC Dog Import Form receipt accepted

sources.authority: US CDC (Centers for Disease Control and Prevention)
sources.page_title: Entry Requirements for Dogs from Dog-Rabies Free or Low-Risk Countries (CDC dog-import rule, 42 CFR 71.51)
sources.applies_to: the CDC federal dog-import layer for a dog arriving from a low-risk-origin country (microchip, minimum age 6 months, low-risk history, CDC Dog Import Form receipt)
supporting_requirements: dog at least 6 months old at arrival
prior-6-month history is CDC low-risk (not high-risk/unlisted)
CBP documentation check + visual inspection on arrival
